title: Misleading subscription flow
body:
The app itself might be fine, but the subscription handling is a serious red flag.
I tried to check my active subscriptions via the in-app link — it redirected to the iPhone’s subscription settings, where this app didn’t show up. Naturally, I assumed I wasn’t subscribed.
No renewal reminder, no visible active subscription — and then, suddenly, a charge.
This is not just a poor UX choice — it feels deliberately misleading. If canceling requires emailing support, that should be front and center, not hidden in fine print.
As a paying user, I expect transparency — not unpleasant surprises and manual guesswork.
Still no answer from the support team.
author: arctangel

title: Отвратительное отношение
